title: PIZZA INVADERS
oneLiner: Blast the cheesy pizza invaders before they cover the sky!
mechanics: Move the pizza pan left and right along the bottom.
Press A to fire sauce blasts at descending pizza aliens.
Pizza invaders drop toppings that hurt the pan.
Clear waves for points; each wave moves faster and fires more often.
lose: Lose when a pizza reaches the pan or a topping hits it.
scoring: Score points for blasting pizza invaders, with bonus points for clearing a wave.
